name: Hair By Adrii Santos
about:
Hi, I’m Adrii, and I’ve been a professional hairstylist since 2018. Hair is more than just my career—it’s my passion. I specialize in lived-in, rooty hair color that enhances your natural beauty, whether you’re blonde, brunette, red, or love bold, vivid colors. I also take pride in creating intentional, customized women’s haircuts that blend texture with softness and glamour, with a special focus on natural texture-friendly styles. 

I’m dedicated to continuous learning and growth, always staying on top of the latest techniques to provide my clients with the best possible experience. I’m so grateful for everyone who has trusted me with their hair over the years, and I can’t wait to welcome new guests to my chair. My goal is to help you feel confident and beautiful with hair that truly reflects your unique style.

When I’m not in the salon, I’m a mom to the most wonderful little boy, a happy wife, and a lover of all things creative. I enjoy cooking, baking, reading, exploring new coffee spots, brunching with friends, and collecting tattoos.

Let’s work together to create hair that makes you feel radiant inside and out!
